entries.title: Runtime and storage
entries.implemented: Single multicall binary, SQLite and PostgreSQL stores, migrations, and CI

entries.title: Security foundations
entries.implemented: Envelope encryption, authorization chokepoint, append-only audit trails, and gap-free PostgreSQL audit export

entries.title: Core API and CLI
entries.implemented: Bootstrap administration, local login, hierarchy CRUD, key declarations, validation, encrypted values, copy, clone, and bulk apply

entries.title: Human identity and access
entries.implemented: OIDC, WebAuthn, TOTP, recovery, sessions, grants, role templates, protected environments, and member invitation at org and instance scope from API, CLI and WebUI with browser credential establishment and recovery-code sign-in

entries.title: Matrix and disclosure UI
entries.implemented: Embedded app shell, environment matrix, row editor, problems filter, reveal/copy ceremonies, protected publish flows, key declaration from the matrix, catalogue declaration detail and editing, and key rename/reclassify/delete

entries.title: Machine access
entries.implemented: Service accounts with browser create/delete, display-once credentials, OIDC workload federation with browser issuer and binding administration, receiving-side connection credentials, and machine-access UI

entries.title: Multi-instance workspaces
entries.implemented: Directory-tier remotes and browser-direct workspace sessions

entries.title: Enterprise identity protocols
entries.implemented: SAML service-provider support and SCIM provisioning, fully open-source

entries.title: Backup and restore
entries.implemented: Encrypted export/restore plus the cross-engine recovery drill

entries.title: Revision lifecycle
entries.implemented: Drafts, snapshots, selective publish, rollback, durable pins, retention, GC, and history restore/pin lifecycle

entries.title: Administration UI
entries.implemented: Members at organisation, project and instance scope, organisation/project/instance settings, account security, browser step-up, OIDC/SAML/SCIM provider administration, organisation, project and environment audit query and export, and remote cryptographic maintenance

entries.title: Imports and onboarding
entries.implemented: Kubernetes, SOPS, and Infisical file imports; live Kubernetes and Vault/OpenBao connectors; import wizard; dotenv scaffolding; browser imports of .env, Kubernetes, Infisical, and Vault/OpenBao sources

entries.title: Delivery
entries.implemented: Compose delivery and `hikyo run`, Kubernetes operator/CRDs, Forgejo and GitHub Actions adapters with multi-target synchronization and a browser-operated adapter lifecycle, and machine-reveal opt-in

entries.title: Key rotation
entries.implemented: Root, master, DEK, token, and scanning-key rotation plus resumable re-encryption

entries.title: Secret scanning
